passage:
council — 市议会；委员会
Last year, the city council introduced a new transport policy.

lane — 车道
One lane on each road was closed to private cars and opened only to buses and bicycles.

permanent — 永久的
Finally, the policy was made permanent in September.

benefited — 受益；获益
The report showed that bus passengers and cyclists benefited most.

complaints — 投诉；抱怨
The council listened to these complaints.

reduction — 减少；降低
The second was to give small shops a reduction in their business taxes.

unfair — 不公平的
A group of drivers, called 'Fair Roads', says the policy is unfair.

unequal — 不平等的；不均衡的
The effects of such policies are often unequal.
